header: Create and conﬁgure an OpenSearch application to view Cluster Insights
content:
Cluster Insights
You can view insights for a speciﬁc OpenSearch Service cluster through the OpenSearch UI
(Dashboards). In OpenSearch UI, an application is simply an organizational construct like a folder.
Beneﬁts
1279
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
Each application can connect to and display insights for multiple OpenSearch Service clusters.
Accessing Cluster Insights requires an administrative role in the OpenSearch UI application.
